newsitem.title: FINLAND: FSB CLIENTS CAN PLACE BUY/SELL ORDERS ON INTERNET.
newsitem.headline: FSB CLIENTS CAN PLACE BUY/SELL ORDERS ON INTERNET.

text.p: Finnish brokerage Suomen FSB Oy Pankkiiriliike said on Tuesday it was launching a new service allowing clients to send buy and sell orders to FSB on the Internet.
The aim of the Internet brokerage service is to make it easier for private investors to trade in stocks and to reduce overall transaction costs, FSB chairman Pekka Pere told a news conference.
"The new service is mainly targeted at small investors as that is where the biggest growth potential lies," he said.
The new service will help FSB win new customers as it is the first Finnish brokerage to offer services on the Internet, Pere said, but declined to give any exact forecasts about trading volumes.
He said clients can also check the status of their buying and selling orders placed via the Internet service, and read FSB's weekly stock recommendations and market reports.
